title: Streetball Court Upgrade at Sportplatz Stegacker

Targets seniors, women, newcomer families and intergenerational neighbourhood groups. title: Witikon Pop-up Neighbourhood Theatre
description: A summer open-air theatre series at Witikonplatz / Witikerpark (Witikon) for local families, seniors and youths. Partner with local amateur groups and run a three-month community casting and rehearsal period leading to weekend performances in July–August.

description: Weekly pop-up café at Schwamendingerplatz (in front of Schwamendingen Bahnhof) offering language practice, digital help and social connection for migrants, seniors and unemployed residents. Target beneficiaries: newcomers, elderly people, jobseekers and local families in Kreis 12. Implementation step: run a 12-week pilot with a weekly Wednesday evening session (16:00–19:00), recruiting bilingual volunteers from Quartierverein Schwamendingen and Stadtbibliothek Schwamendingen to host conversation tables and device help.

title: Intergenerational modular co-housing at Schwamendingenplatz

Target beneficiaries: low-income families, students and seniors in Kreis 12 facing housing insecurity. Exact location: Schwamendingerstrasse (Schwamendingerplatz → Saatlen junction). Implementation step: pilot a protected lane using removable bollards and planters for 6 months, then evaluate user counts and safety incidents before making it permanent.

title: Real‑time bus shelters at Saatlen hub

Exact location: Saatlenstrasse bus stops adjacent to Schulhaus Saatlen. Implementation step: install two shelters and one digital timetable display as a 3-month pilot, monitor reliability and user feedback.

title: Community cargo‑bike hub by Bahnhof Stettbach (Hirzenbach)

Exact location: plaza on the Hirzenbach/Stettbach station forecourt. title: Smart sensor recycling stations at Schwamendingenplatz

title: Schwamendingen Pop-up Micro-Enterprise Incubator

description: Install a sheltered telemedicine kiosk with a privacy booth and multilingual touchscreen at Schwamendingerplatz (intersection Schwamendingerstrasse / Wallisellenstrasse).
